instrument: A796/S731, large data center tariff law (signed July 7, 2026)
summary: Directs the Board of Public Utilities to create special electric service rules for new and existing data centers with peak demand of 50 MW or more (or a lower BPU threshold), aggregating facilities under common ownership or on contiguous sites; customers must guarantee at least 85% of requested service for at least 10 years and post deposits for new transmission; data centers are curtailed before residential customers in emergencies; incentives for own clean generation or storage. BPU rules due within 12 months; utilities apply them within 180 days after.

source.citation: Assembly sponsor release (July 7, 2026); New Jersey Monitor
